messages:
From: Alicia Bryant <alicia@beaconai.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-01T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Request: short-term top-up for high-QPS rehearsal

Hi Vivek,

Thanks again for the demo last week — BeaconAI is moving quickly and we want to run a high-fidelity rehearsal ahead of our pilot. We plan a 48h soak (Jul 3–4) that includes several high-QPS windows to validate p95 latency and tail behavior under production-like traffic. Expected profile: sustained bursts up to ~4k RPS for 30–60 minute windows, overall token consumption estimate ~2.3M tokens over 48h.

Can Redwood provision a short-term credit top-up or promotional voucher to cover the run? Ideally this would be a one-time sandbox allowance that keeps our trial non-blocking and lets us validate latency targets. If there are guardrails (rate limits, model fallbacks) you need us to agree to, we can accept them.

Attached is a brief runbook and expected traffic curves. Let me know what info you need from our side.

Thanks,
Alicia Bryant
Director, Platform Partnerships
BeaconAI

On Mon, Jul 1, 2028 at 9:42 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com> wrote:
> Ben — can you confirm the model variant and rough token estimate from our side and any technical guardrails we should require?

Alicia / Vivek — quick tech note from SE: for BeaconAI's profile the most cost-effective path is running the rehearsal against redwood/gpt-neo-13b-int8 (verified for high-throughput). For the burst windows we recommend enabling prefix KV caching and a short LRU TTL to avoid reloading repeated contexts.

Risk/notes:
- p95 latency is likely to be fine if we cap concurrency per connection and avoid huge single-request context sizes; you should aim for request sizes <1k tokens where possible.
- If you need strict 99th percentile SLAs, we should route bursts to a dedicated pool (more expensive) — we can fallback to smaller model variants if the shared sandbox gets congested.

Suggested top-up: provision a temporary sandbox voucher equivalent to 2.5M tokens (usable only during Jul 3–4). That should give headroom for the bursts + retries.

I’ve attached a short soak worksheet (soak-plan.xlsx) with estimated token burn by window.
[attachment: soak-plan.xlsx]

Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
